physical_scale: Unspecified. One visual authoring pitch is 1 BU, not a meter conversion.
origin: Center of nominal XY catalog footprint, bottom z=0
art_direction: Broad planar chamfers, layered silhouette, a quiet inset armor face; credible spacecraft skin. Seam repetition should remain calm in large fields. No lamps, exposed bolts, handles, vents, decals or small floating hardware.
materials: Reuse current style palette Armor, Ceramic, Titanium/Dark; no emission or images. Prefer two materials, restrained contrast.
edge_contract: Retain exact catalog polygon at bottom structural envelope. Coplanar straight join walls for z=0..0.16. Only the exposed upper face may have chamfers/corner cuts/insets; no geometry outside nominal XY boundary. Consistent top z=0.28. No scales other than one.
deliverables: Standalone editable Parts/<ID>/blend + part.json; assembled Blocks/<ID>/blend + assembly.json + final Exports/<ID>.glb + validation.json + short composition plan/README. No intermediate variants, archives, user comparison renders. Internal final review renders in TEMP only.
validation: Reopen source, GLB roundtrip, embedded materials, no emission, finite transforms, evaluated triangle count, no zero-area faces, no boundary overshoot. Inspect final oblique/top plus tiled/neighbouring final instances in TEMP; no display props in final export.
